name: HelpPopover
intent: A small help panel with an optional title and a short paragraph, opened from a ? icon beside a label or setting.
usage: Wrap one focusable trigger, usually a ? help icon, in HelpPopover and pass title and content. It shows on hover and keyboard focus, and a click or tap pins it open until a click elsewhere, Escape, or another click. Form fields already use it: pass help on Input, Textarea, Select, DatePicker, FormulaEditor or FormDisplay and the label becomes the title. For a one-line name on an icon button, use Tooltip. See contracts/helppopover.json for the full contract. A portaled panel takes the theme of whatever opened it, so it is dark with a dark app frame even though it is drawn at the end of the page.

title.note: Bold header on a faint band. Leave it out for body text only.

content.note: One to three short sentences. Plain text.

placement.note: Preferred side. Flips when there is no room and stays inside the frame it is in — the app frame when the screen sits in one, else the window; the arrow keeps pointing at the trigger.

delay.note: Milliseconds of hover before it shows. Keyboard focus and click show it at once.

open.note: Controlled. true keeps it shown, false keeps it hidden.

disabled.note: No panel; the child renders on its own.

children.note: One focusable trigger, like a ? icon button. It gets aria-describedby.

useWhen: A ? icon beside a form label or a setting that needs a sentence or two of explanation.
Help that needs a title, like the name of the field it explains.
doNot: Do not invent Popover, HoverCard, InfoTip, ContextInfo or a local help panel.
Do not use for an icon button's name. Use Tooltip.
Do not put links, buttons or forms in it. Use Modal.
Do not put required instructions in it. Use the field's hint.
a11y: The title and text are always in the page as the trigger's description (aria-describedby), so screen readers get them on focus.
Shows on hover after the delay and at once on keyboard focus. Enter, Space, a click or a tap pins it open.
Escape, a click elsewhere, or moving focus away closes it. Escape does not close an enclosing Modal.
The pointer can move onto the panel to read it. It is fixed to the window, so containers never clip it.
snippet:
<HelpPopover title="Tax ID" content="The number on your tax registration, like EU123456789.">
  <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconOnly iconStart="help_center">About Tax ID</Button>
</HelpPopover>

examples.title: With a title
examples.usage: The title names what the text explains. Hover, Tab or click the ? icon.

props.title: Tax ID
props.content: The number on your tax registration, like EU123456789. We print it on every invoice.

examples.title: Body only
examples.usage: Leave out title for a single short explanation.

props.content: Invoices that match this rule cannot be sent until someone approves them.

examples.title: Placement
examples.usage: Below by default, like Figma. It flips when the preferred side has no room.

props.title: Above
props.content: Use when the space below is taken.

examples.title: On a form field
examples.usage: Pass help on a kit field. Its label becomes the title.
